Institute: Greenvale College of Engineering
Permanent Id: 1-5827420
Application: APP-18 (2027-28)

The following deficiencies were found in the application for Extension of Approval:
1. Occupancy / Completion Certificate missing (Occupancy / Completion Certificate)
   An Occupancy / Completion Certificate (or Building License / Form D) issued by the Competent Authority is required.
   Handbook: "ANNEXURE-2 2.1 iii. - As per Clause 7.17 of the Approval Process Handbook, valid Occupancy/ Completion Certificate/ Building License/ Form D issued by the Competent Authority."
   To submit: Upload a valid Occupancy / Completion Certificate.

Draft prepared by Pramaan (advisory). To be reviewed and signed by the competent officer.
